title: Ninety-Five Percent Exhaustive Test Coverage
description: Instrument coverage measurement (vitest v8, cargo-llvm-cov, go -cover, pytest-cov, coverlet) across the whole repo, aggregate to one repo-wide LCOV, gate `bun ./📜️script.ts test exhaustive` at a hard 95% line-coverage threshold, close the test-exhaustive nx target gap (~170 project.json files), then run a parallel agent workforce (Workflow tool, ~50-item waves) to write the missing tests until the gate passes.
